prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ZuluNiner aviation blog cover, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: restrained aircraft-focused editorial illustration for an article comparing sport-pilot and private-pilot aircraft choices after MOSAIC.
Scene/backdrop: two conventional light single-engine piston airplanes parked on a quiet apron beside a modest hangar: a high-wing four-seat trainer and a smaller low-wing two-seat trainer. Keep their silhouettes separate and their wings, tails and propellers coherent. No people.
Style/medium: refined somewhat abstract aviation-magazine graphic, clean aircraft shapes, lightly textured surfaces, muted blue, ivory and warm grey, calm daylight.
Composition/framing: three-quarter view with both aircraft prominent and complete, generous margins around wingtips and tails, uncluttered background, readable at thumbnail size.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no charts, no registration marks, no logos and no watermark. No claims of sport-pilot eligibility conveyed by badges. Fictional aircraft illustration, not photographs of actual listings.
